To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) 123 articles were selected from 2008–2012 on the use of DM techniques for construction of decision models for supplier-selection, (2) the selected articles were classified into seven categories based on the uncertainty of supplier selection, (3) 26 DM techniques were identified and reviewed, and (4) the integration methods of these techniques were discussed.

the following 26 DM techniques have been applied in uncertain supplier selection: AHP, ANP, AHP-ANP, ANP-AHP, TOPSIS, PROMETHEE, VIKOR, ELECTRE, AHP-DEA, AHP-GP, AHP-MP, AHP-GM, ANP-GP, A-NP-GM, AN-P-GM, TOPSIS-GP, TOPSIS-MP, TOPS- IS

the application of DM technique for supplier selection can be roughly classified into seven types: (1) deterministic supplier selection, (2) stochastic supplier selection, (3) fuzzy supplier selection, (4) interval supplier selection, (5) random supplier selection, (6) rough set supplier selection, and (7) supplier selection with other types of uncertainties.

the application of DM methods in supplier selection, and the main contribution of this paper is to provide a systematic review of the literature.
